## What Real Users Say

Customer reviews highlighted on Partnero’s own site and third-party review platforms consistently mention ease of setup, a clean interface, and reliable Stripe integration as standout points. One reviewer running Partnero at Tomba.io for over two years specifically called out reliability and ease of managing partner commissions as reasons they have stuck with the platform long term. Another reviewer described being able to launch a feature-rich affiliate program in one to two hours, which lines up with the AI program builder’s stated goal of speeding up initial setup. [...] The most common critical feedback across review platforms centers on the learning curve for more advanced commission structures and the fact that additional team seats add up quickly for larger teams needing more than one or two users per plan. According to G2’s Partnero review page, reviewers consistently rate the platform highly on ease of setup and support responsiveness relative to comparable affiliate tools.
